dialogues.speaker: "Raging Wind Nanasian"
dialogues.text: Nobody's ever gonna be able to beat that guy...

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: You shouldn't think like that. We thought "Easy Come" and "Easy Go" were undefeatable, but hey, someone better came along today, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: I'm sure that someday, in the future, we'll get a new champion, speedier than ever before.

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Good luck! Maybe you'll be one of those who gets a shot at that glory, hmm?
